text:
[LSER.14.4.5] **No aggregation is backed on `tumbling` in this edition.** The
compiler **must** refuse every `tumbling` line, whatever its aggregation, with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING` ([LSER.15.2], [LSER.18]). A per-bucket
backing is what the model needs and none ships. [LSER.14.4.1], [LSER.14.4.2]
and [LSER.14.4.4] state what a `tumbling` line means where an edition admits one; none of them
binds this edition.
